svg.title: Deadlines, cancellation and errors
svg.desc: Replies default to a 16 MiB bound, including the JSON-line framing. Configure max_reply_bytes (Python) / maxReplyBytes (TypeScript and Swift) for larger screenshots or downloads. Oversized or malformed replies close the socket; a later explicit command can establish another connection. This is reconnection, not replay of the failed command.
